components.name: ArchitectureDiagram
components.teaches: Static block diagram of UVM/SV components, containers, TLM ports and connections on a grid.
components.props: Required: title (accessible name), caption (what to look at), nodes[]. Optional: ports[], edges[], cellWidth (150), cellHeight (60), gapX (64), gapY (76), legend (default true when ports or edges exist), spreadAnchors (default false; spreads edges meeting one node side), className. node: {id, label, sublabel?, kind?, col, row (zero-based), colSpan?, rowSpan?, container? (drawn around the cells it spans; nested containers grow margins), state? normal|active|dim|error|ok, badge?}. node kind: test env agent sequencer driver monitor scoreboard subscriber predictor model fifo sequence dut interface reg generic. port: {id, node, side left|right|top|bottom, at? 0..1 (0.5), kind port|export|imp|analysis_port|analysis_imp, label?}; port ids must not clash with node ids. edge: {id?, from, to (node or port ids), style? data (solid, filled arrow)|control (dotted)|causal (dashed, call order)|structural (plain), label?, via? [[col,row],...] bend points in grid units, fractions ok}. Limits: leaf nodes must not overlap and ids must be unique (a red Diagram data error shows and the lesson sweep fails); a diagram over 400 units wide keeps scale 0.9 and scrolls sideways on phones (use cellWidth 120 gapX 48 for phones); edge label chip is 6.2 px per char + 8, so a 10-char label hides the line across the default 64 px gap (warnings: label-hides-edge, label-same-point, label-overlap, label-on-node, container-same-span; fix with shorter label, wider gaps, via, spreadAnchors); two containers must not span identical cells.

components.name: TimingDiagram
components.teaches: Cycle-accurate waveform: bits and buses sampled at rising clock edges with markers and highlights.
components.props: Required: title, caption (string or node), edges (number of rising edges drawn), signals[]. Optional: markers[], highlights[], cycleWidth (44), className. signal: {name, kind clock|bit|bus, values? (clock ignores values; values[k] is the value sampled at rising edge k; undefined = X; bus values are strings or numbers)}. marker: {edge, tone pass|fail|vacuous|pending|info|sample|drive, label (must explain itself), glyph?, short?}. highlight: {from, to, tone? attempt|fail|pass|info, label?}. Limits: values.length must be <= edges; marker.edge must be in 0..edges-1; a violation shows a Diagram data error. For WaveDrom use ProtocolWaveform.

components.name: SequenceDiagram
components.teaches: Ordered message-sequence diagram: who calls whom, returns, async sends, self calls, notes and dividers.
components.props: Required: title, caption, participants[], messages[]. Optional: numbered (default true; numbers call/return/async/self steps), columnWidth (160 per lifeline), className. participant: {id, label, sublabel?, kind? (same node kinds as ArchitectureDiagram)}. message: {kind? call (default, solid)|return (dashed)|async (open head)|self (loop on one lifeline, no to)|note (spans from..to; to optional)|divider (time passes, e.g. @(posedge clk)), from?, to?, label, tone? normal|active|error}. Limits: participant boxes are 130 px wide so columnWidth below 130 overlaps them (default 160); from/to must be participant ids and must differ for call/return/async (use kind self); labels wrap to 3 lines (notes 4); canvas widens for long self-message text and scrolls on phones; a 'Steps as text' list is generated for screen readers.
